review_kind: Eight complete pinned developer documentation and workflow packages; candidate source-vetting only, NOT governed review
macro_findings: Eight complete packages inspected at one pinned source revision; seven SKILL-only packages and one SKILL plus bundled reference. Pinned generated upstream skill index supplies package asset listing; no external tools executed.

Six hard-fail unchanged reuse: private Copilot session reads, authenticated browser interaction, filesystem overwrite, root AGENTS.md write, Git pull/branch mutation and ADR persistence lack action-specific authority. Two reference-only prompt/commit drafting procedures require privacy/evidence scoping.

Source-level MIT terms reused once with per-skill rights caveats. Distinct skill identities and global deduplicated denominator remain unresolved; source-vetting grades are not governed admissions or behavioral validation.
Capability overlap with existing reviewed commit, browser testing and developer documentation examples; differentiation must be established before any future admission.
